name: theme-builder
description: A source-owned Dioxus-only full theme customization builder for Dioxus (no shadcn equivalent), backed by the owned adico primitive layer.

documentation.compositionNote: Dioxus-only extra with no shadcn equivalent -- classified `EXISTING_DIOXUS_EXTRA` per design.md §7d (no shadcn/dioxus-components catalog counterpart in statics/component_compatibility.json). Promotes apps/playground's advanced customization tray -- the full 28-semantic-token editor with independent light/dark values, a deterministic 'generate theme' action, and CSS export -- into a real, generic, installable component, since none of it is actually playground-specific in nature. Applies its edited tokens live through adico_primitives::theme_mode::apply_root_properties, the same document-root mechanism theme-switcher already uses for its 4 properties, so theme-builder composes with mode-toggle/theme-switcher on one mechanism. Renders its CSS export into a read-only, selectable textarea. **2026-09-06:** the export now also has a working copy button, composing the new `copy-button` registry item rather than calling the browser clipboard API directly -- that keeps this file free of browser-interop details (the API call lives behind `adico-primitives`'s target-gated `clipboard` primitive) and needs no new cargo dependency of its own beyond the `copy-button` item's own existing ones. `registryDependencies` is now `["cn", "copy-button"]`.
documentation.accessibility: A styled composition around `theme_mode`'s `ThemeMode` primitive (`packages/adico-primitives/src/theme_mode.rs`); its editable token controls and CSS-export text area are plain form controls with native semantics, no custom ARIA widget roles.
documentation.keyboard: No custom keyboard layer; native form-control and button keyboard behavior throughout.
